draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your Houston camera and access-control installs - 8 or 24 ports, your label possible
draft_en.body:
Hello Nexlar team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches in your camera and access-control installs: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based, FCC/CE/RoHS - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, STC-424DGGPM-280W, $140.1. For gate and yard cabinets there is a DIN-rail industrial version (-40 to 75 C). Nexlar label on the unit is possible from small lots.

One question: which port count do your Houston projects use most, 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
